Want to know how to make your home energy efficient? Home window tinting is an effective way to make your home more energy-efficient and also has a lot of other benefits too! Below find out how to make your house energy efficient with window tinting.

Tint a Home specialises in home window tinting and is Australia’s most trusted window tinting network. We have provided tinting services in Australia for 40+ years, offer lifetime warranties on residential applications and all installations are done by professionally training installers. Here is how you can make your house more energy efficient:

How To Make Your House More Energy Efficient With Window Tinting

How to make your house more energy efficient with window tinting comes down to the type of film you choose. The most effective tint for how to make your house energy efficient is our solar film. Because it dramatically reduces the heat entering your home and makes it cosier during winter months this is how it makes your house energy efficient. It means less air conditioning and heating which of course has a positive impact on energy efficiency AND your power bills!

It also makes your home more comfortable all year round and you have the added benefit of a reduction in UV wear & tear that fades carpets, floorboards & furniture. You can also choose reflective films that add ultimate privacy with those on the outside unable to see in and lighter films that don’t alter the appearance of your home.

Other window films in our range include:

  • Privacy film
  • Safety film
  • Security film
  • Decorative film
